hooks.command: for engine in .agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/bin/*/impeccable; do if [ -x ".agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable" ] && [ -x "$engine" ]; then ".agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable" hook; exit $?; fi; done; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: if /I "%PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE%"=="ARM64" (if exist ".agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/bin/windows-arm64/impeccable.exe" (".agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable.cmd" hook & exit /b)) else (if exist ".agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/bin/windows-x64/impeccable.exe" (".agents/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable.cmd" hook & exit /b)); exit /b 0
